findings.detail: Photo measurement and several MSL helper actions wrote quick-entry values programmatically without an explicit progress-source event. They now dispatch sk:ctu-system-applied/sk:ctu-photo-applied with the affected field ids.
Automatic photo-AI values are tracked as suggested/review-required and are not treated as operator-confirmed values until explicit AI apply or trusted operator confirmation.
HTML defaults do not mark progress complete. A real operator/helper action can still confirm a value even when it equals the original default.
The current importer writes quickMass/quickCargoDescription before emitting sk:ctu-excel-imported.
Legacy updateCtuReview no longer force-enables registration. Registration buttons are enabled only after a current successful calculation with no invalidating input changes.
Automated Chromium simulation passed: initial -> Excel -> AI suggested -> AI confirmed -> MSL confirmed -> calculated -> edited/recalculation-required, with registration gating at each state.
Automated Chromium scroll test kept ctuStickyStatus at the shared header boundary (58px in the test harness).

limitations: Image-recognition accuracy for every real-world photo is not asserted; this verification covers the code/event/input/progress linkage and safety gating.
